blocks.html: Fields that can be passed in the query parameters of a request.

types.name: fields
types.description:
Comma-separated fields that should be included in the returned data.
if a field is prefixed with `+` it will be added to the default fields, using `-` will remove it from the default fields.
without prefix it will replace the entire default fields.

types.name: offset
types.description: The number of items to skip when retrieving a list.

types.name: limit
types.description: Limit the number of items returned in the list.

types.name: order
types.description: The field to sort the data by. By default, the sort order is ascending. To change the order to descending, prefix the field name with `-`.

types.name: with_deleted
types.description: Whether to include deleted records in the result.
